stories.summary: The Leonid meteor shower, known for its bright and fast meteors, will kick off this weekend and continue until the end of November. The Leonid meteor shower is set to dazzle sky gazers across the UK throughout November. The celestial spectacle takes place from now until 30 November with the peak taking place on the night of 17 November. The shower is made up of dust particles from the Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, which leaves a trail of debris as it follows its path around the Sun. These particles enter the Earth's atmosphere at up to 44 miles (71km) per second - meaning these streaks of light are the fastest meteors in the sky.
